blocks.text: HOT TUB REMOVAL FAQ
Hot Tub Removal in Oshawa — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does hot tub removal cost in Oshawa?
a: Pricing is confirmed free at the walkthrough based on the tub’s size and condition — the number covers the whole job.

items.q: Can a hot tub be removed between tenants without slipping the lease?
a: That’s standard work for us, especially near the colleges. Removal books between move-out and move-in, documented for your landlord file.

items.q: Our hot tub hasn't been used in years — is that a problem?
a: Not for us. Tubs that have sat unused often come with corroded fittings, and we handle that as routine.

items.q: Do I need to drain the hot tub myself before you arrive?
a: No — draining is part of the service. No hose, pump, or prep needed beyond reasonably clear access.

items.q: Is it safe to remove a hot tub that's still wired to electrical?
a: Only once the power is confirmed off. A hardwired 240V connection needs prior disconnection by a licensed electrician.
